en_title: James Cameron Congratulates Marvel After Avengers: Endgame Beats Avatar at the Box Office Yet Again
cn_title: 漫威再夺票房榜首，卡梅隆发文祝贺
subtitle: 钢铁侠做客潘多拉
opus_summary: 《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》重映后再超《阿凡达》，重登全球影史票房榜首。卡梅隆发文祝贺漫威，并分享钢铁侠被纳美人围住的图片。两片多年来已数次交换榜首位置。

paragraphs.en: James Cameron celebrated Avengers: Endgame beating Avatar at the box office with another social media post after the two movies traded places yet again.
paragraphs.cn: 《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》与《阿凡达》的票房排名再次易位后，詹姆斯·卡梅隆又在社交媒体发文，祝贺《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》超越《阿凡达》。

paragraphs.en: The director behind the smash-hit sci-fi franchise brought Iron Man to the world of Pandora with an image he shared on Instagram today. The update arrived after Marvel Studios' recent re-release, Avengers: Endgame Encore , managed to bring in enough cash to (re)secure its place as the highest-grossing film of all time.
paragraphs.cn: 这位热门科幻系列的导演今天在Instagram分享了一张图片，将钢铁侠带到了潘多拉世界。此前，漫威影业近期重映的《Avengers: Endgame Encore》凭借新增票房，再次登上全球影史票房榜首。

paragraphs.en: "'You are one of the people,'" the post, accompanied by a picture of Iron Man surrounded by Na'vi, said. "Congratulations to Marvel and the #1 Avengers: Endgame: Encore for bringing moviegoers to the cinemas – Jim Cameron."
paragraphs.cn: 帖文配上了一张钢铁侠被纳美人围住的图片，写道：「你是我们族人的一员。」「祝贺漫威和登上榜首的《Avengers: Endgame: Encore》，感谢你们将观众带进电影院。——吉姆·卡梅隆」

paragraphs.en: It's more friendly competition in the movie space that is only the latest update in a race that has seen Avatar and Avengers: Endgame trading titles for years. Marvel originally overtook Avatar's record as the highest-grossing movie in the world when it released in 2019. Cameron shared a similarly congratulatory post at the time but later went on to predict that Avatar would reclaim the throne just a few months later. He was proven right in 2021.
paragraphs.cn: 这又是电影界的一次友好竞争，也是两片多年票房角逐的最新进展：《阿凡达》和《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》多年来已数次交换榜首位置。漫威这部电影在2019年上映时，首次超越《阿凡达》创下的全球影史票房纪录。卡梅隆当时也发过类似的祝贺帖文，但几个月后又预言，《阿凡达》会夺回冠军宝座。2021年，他的预言得到了验证。

paragraphs.en: As Avatar sequels The Way of Water and Fire and Ash came and went, so too did more Marvel Cinematic Universe movies. As Marvel prepared for the release of its new team-up movie, Avengers: Doomsday , this December, it saw an opportunity to revisit the events of Endgame with new bonus footage , thrusting it into the future by revisiting the past.
paragraphs.cn: 随着《阿凡达》的续作《阿凡达：水之道》和《阿凡达：火与烬》相继上映，漫威电影宇宙也陆续推出了更多作品。漫威在为今年12月上映的新一部英雄集结电影《复仇者联盟：毁灭之日》做准备时，看到了借新增片段重温《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》故事的机会，通过回顾过去，将故事推向未来。

paragraphs.en: It was a re-release that proved fruitful for the comic book movie company, with Avengers: Endgame going on to nab a big opening weekend at the box office . Despite a massive drop in its second return weekend in theaters, the film reclaimed its title as the highest-grossing movie ever .
paragraphs.cn: 这次重映为这家漫画电影公司带来了丰厚回报，《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》重映首周末取得了亮眼票房。尽管重映第二周末票房大幅下跌，该片仍夺回了全球影史票房冠军的头衔。

paragraphs.en: Re-releases and original premieres included, the final tally, as shared by Box Office Mojo , puts Marvel and the Russo brothers' Avengers: Endgame in first with $2.938 billion and Cameron's Avatar in second with $2.923 billion. Both movies are within spitting distance of the fabled $3 billion number and still miles ahead of this year's third-place champion, Spider-Man: Brand New Day ($2.513 billion). Whether either of them will ever trade places again remains to be seen.
paragraphs.cn: 据Box Office Mojo公布的最终统计，计入首轮上映和重映票房后，漫威与罗素兄弟的《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》以29.38亿美元(约合人民币197亿元)位居第一，卡梅隆的《阿凡达》以29.23亿美元(约合人民币196亿元)排名第二。两部电影距离30亿美元(约合人民币201亿元)这一令人向往的门槛都只有一步之遥，也依然遥遥领先于今年跻身第三名的《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》，后者票房为25.13亿美元(约合人民币168亿元)。两片未来是否还会再次交换排名，仍有待观察。

paragraphs.en: At least in terms of IGN reviews, Avengers: Endgame still came out on top. We gave the Marvel movie a 9.5/10 review at the time of its release in 2019. Cameron's 2009 sci-fi movie earned a 9/10 .
paragraphs.cn: 至少在IGN评分上，《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》仍然略胜一筹。2019年该片上映时，我们给出了9.5分，满分10分。卡梅隆2009年上映的科幻电影《阿凡达》则获得了9分。
